package.name: color_nav
package.description:
Colour-based visual servoing for TurtleBot3 (ROS 2 Humble / Gazebo Classic).
The package provides a single unified node — VisualServoing — that: • Subscribes to /camera/image_raw and performs real-time HSV colour segmentation to locate a green target sphere. • Uses a proportional (P) controller to align the robot with the target centroid and drives forward when alignment is within threshold. • Subscribes to /scan (LiDAR) to perform proximity-based safety stops. • Publishes velocity commands on /cmd_vel.
Also ships a Gazebo Classic world (green_sphere.world) and a ready-to-use launch file that brings up the full simulation stack.
Designed for robotic evaluation pipelines — no external subpackages required.
